messages:
anya: Heads-up: experimenting with replacing immediate pagers for autofallbacks with a digest + a console-sticky alert. Primary goal: reduce noise for bursty routes while preserving auditability.

 tom: Agree. Also watch for cross-route spillover if we start silencing alerts on high-volume routes. Could shift load elsewhere.

 ravi: Proposed metrics: fallback_events_total (1m), fallback_unique_routes_5m, fallback_shifts (routes that increase after throttle). Those will drive the digest thresholds.

 michael: For audit payloads we must avoid storing full prompts. Suggest fields: evt_id, ts, route, rollout_id, decision_path, reason_code, fallback_model, original_model, latency_ms, redaction_level, prompt_sig, excerpt, telemetry_tags, retention_days.

 tom: Sketching a flat JSON we can write to stream and sanitize later:
 ```json
{
  "evt": "fb_01Gabc",
  "ts": 1761234999,
  "route": "payments/charge",
  "rollout_id": "rl_2026_canary_17",
  "decision_path": "policy.latency->degrade_small",
  "reason_code": "LATENCY_P90_OVER",
  "fallback_model": "x-small-quant",
  "original_model": "x-large-v2",
  "latency_ms": 1420,
  "redaction_level": "partial",
  "prompt_sig": "sha256:deadbeef",
  "excerpt": "[redacted] order id 1234 ...",
  "telemetry_tags": "fallback,digest,alert_eligible:false",
  "retention_days": 30
}
```

 michael: Sanity checks: telemetry_tags must stay flat (CSV). excerpt must be size-limited and replaced with "[redacted]" by sanitizer when PII detected. sreb: policy: any redaction_level == "none" requires a compliance ticket.

 anya: UX: console rollout row shows small badge: red = persistent fallback, orange = transient/digested. Clicking opens audit card with a tiny timeline: request -> decision -> returned excerpt. If excerpt is redacted show reason.

 ravi: Dashboard: add panels for digested_vs_paged and unique_routes_impacted_5m. That will help tune thresholds during rollout.

 tom: Paging rule proposal (playbook): page only when fallback_unique_routes_5m >= 4 AND fallback_events_total_1m >= 10. Otherwise send digest to #oncall and pin console.

 oncall: I'll validate thresholds with SLO owners and update paging playbook. Also will add a one-click opt-out on the console for urgent routes.

 anya: Action list: tom -> PR with flat schema + examples, ravi -> metrics + dashboard panels, michael -> sanitizer spec, oncall -> finalize playbook thresholds. Back here next Tue for sign-off. :+1:
